5-Week Box Office Forecasts: AVENGERS ENDGAME: ENCORE and PRIMETIME Chasing Possible $20M+ Frames; DIGGER and VERITY’s Latest Outlooks

Short and sweet update this week, so we’re going paywall-less.

Key Tracking Factors & Rationale:

  • Current Weekend
    • Avengers Endgame: Encore posted $3.8 million from Thursday previews, in line with expectations going into the weekend. Ranges remain favorable toward $20 million-plus this weekend, although some of the bonus footage has leaked online. Always tough to measure that kind of potential impact, especially with a re-release.
    • Primetime posted $2.7 million from previews yesterday as it continues to perform beyond early expectations. Weekend outlooks remain in a wide range between $15 million and $22 million (the low end is looking unlikelier, though) as we’re monitoring how pre-sale and/or metro-heavy the film is in early shows.
      • A fellow A24 release Backrooms-like multiplier gets the pic to just a hair over $20 million this weekend. Our final forecast pinpoint was $18.1 million, though some models obviously indicate it could go a bit higher. Gen Z appeal remains a standout.
  • Full analysis and long range forecasts available to our Substack subscribers
